args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) failed production health checks with an elevated error rate of 18% across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification confirms service is healthy with error rate reduced to 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 — the most recent release with a healthy production status — to all regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` for checkout-api documenting the health check failures and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
